content.text: Back to overviewALDI FAQsALDI Store Phone NumberAnswer/DescriptionEverything we do is to save our shoppers money on the food and products they want most. Rather than hire extra staff to answer phones and retrieve carts, our employees stay focused on serving our shoppers in stores. This saves us money, but more importantly we pass those savings on to our customers. Our website has information about our store locations and hours, current and upcoming ALDI Finds, answers to your frequently asked questions (FAQs). Cookie NoticeALDI and our third-party technology providers use cookies, pixels, and similar tracking technologies on this site to enable essential site functionality and for business analytics purposes, including to analyze site usage and performance and assist in our internal marketing efforts. You may customize your cookie preferences by clicking the “Cookie Preferences” button below. You can also choose accept or reject all non-essential cookies by clicking the buttons below. To learn more, review our Privacy Policy. Cookie Preferences Reject All Non-Essential Accept AllYour opt-out signal has been honored.Cookie PreferencesWhen you visit our website, we and certain third parties, including advertising companies, use cookies, pixels, tags, and similar tracking technologies to collect information about you, your browser and device, and your visits to our website. We and third parties use the information for various purposes such as to make the site work as you expect it to and to improve your experience, to enhance website security, and to show you personalized content, including delivering advertisements that may be relevant to your interests. To opt-out of certain categories of cookies, please click on the toggle button below so it turns grey. Please be sure to click the “Confirm Choices” button at the bottom to save your preferences. If you use different devices or browsers, you may need to indicate your opt-out choices on each of those devices and browsers. If you opt-out of these cookies, you will still see advertising on our site and elsewhere online, but the advertisements you see may be less relevant to you. Under certain circumstances, the collection of personal information through these cookies may be considered “sales” or “sharing” or “targeted advertising” under applicable privacy laws.Performance Cookies Performance Cookies These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and user experience (for example, to remember choices you make when using our site, like your region, language preferences, or login details). They may also allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site, to help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site.
